answer: Identity-bond decay: every identity posts a 100 POA bond that cools like an ember, losing 2% per idle epoch, so after 20 idle epochs it is worth 67 POA. An atlas lists each bond's age to check before trading. Honest agents refresh their bond with real work, free. An attacker with 1,000 fake identities stranded as islands pays 100,000 POA and bleeds 2,000 POA per epoch for nothing, while an honest agent pays one bond, kept alive by working.
